title: Laredo Police Share Recruitment Video Ahead of Nov. 30 Applications; Physical Agility Exam Featured
excerpt: The Laredo Police Department posted a recruitment video on Friday, Nov. 14, highlighting the Physical Agility Exam as an important step in becoming a Laredo police officer. Applications open Nov. 30, with more information at joinlaredopd.com.
content:
The Laredo Police Department is looking for new officers, and it posted a recruitment video on Friday, Nov. 14, to show what the job takes.

“Think you have what it takes?” the department asked in the post. “Becoming a Laredo Police Officer takes more than just wanting the badge.”

The video features the department’s Physical Agility Exam, which the department calls an important step in the hiring process. It shows candidates training through fitness drills, including push-ups, sit-ups, a timed run, an obstacle course, a wall jump and a dummy drag.

The department urges interested candidates not to wait until test day to start training: “Put in the work today so you’re ready when the challenge comes.”

Applications open Nov. 30. More information is available at joinlaredopd.com and from @Joinlaredopd.

Source: Laredo Police Department, Nov. 14, 2026.
